hypotheses.title: Call-Put Implied Volatility Spread (Finding Alphas Ch 23)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly implements the Options Volatility Spread anomaly from Finding Alphas (Chapter 23, Footnote 3, Cremers & Weinbaum 2010). Under put-call parity, at-the-money calls and puts should trade at identical implied volatilities. In practice, institutional informed traders with positive expectations aggressively buy calls, driving call IV above put IV (vol_spread = IV_call - IV_put). Stocks with higher call-implied volatility systematically outperform those with lower call IV by over 50 bps per week. Paired with a short-term price reversal buffer.
confounders: Dividend capture strategies skewing near-term call implied volatility
Short squeeze dynamics artificially inflating call option premiums
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if higher call implied volatility reflects retail lottery buying rather than institutional flow.

candidates.rationale: 30-day ATM call-minus-put implied volatility spread with 5-day price reversal hedge

hypotheses.title: Intermediate Trend with Microstructure Reversal (Finding Alphas Ch 18 & 21)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly implements the classic momentum-reversion dichotomy detailed in Finding Alphas (Chapter 18 & 21, Jegadeesh & Titman 1993). Prices exhibit strong mean-reversion over short 1- to 5-day horizons due to liquidity provision friction, but exhibit robust trend continuation over 2- to 3-month horizons due to gradual institutional information diffusion. Measuring the intermediate 60-day trend skipping the most recent 5 days ((ts_delay(close, 5) - ts_delay(close, 60)) / close) isolates pure institutional drift free from short-term overreaction.
confounders: Broad market trend inflection points and sharp market-wide regime reversals
Earnings announcement gaps resetting intermediate price trends
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha underperforms during broad market volatility spikes when momentum crashes occur.

candidates.expression: 0.80 * signed_power(group_rank((ts_delay(close, 5) - ts_delay(close, 60)) / close, subindustry) - 0.5, 2) - 0.20 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 3) / close, subindustry)
candidates.rationale: Lagged 60-day intermediate trend skipping 5 days paired with 3-day short-term reversal buffer

hypotheses.title: Composite Style Factor Acceleration (Finding Alphas Ch 19, 20 & 31)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly implements multi-factor style acceleration from Finding Alphas (Chapters 19, 20 & 31). WorldQuant BRAIN's composite_factor_score_derivative integrates earnings quality, cash conversion efficiency, and multi-factor revision momentum across 100% of the TOP3000 universe. Evaluating the cross-sectional rank of this derivative identifies turning points in corporate fundamental health before headline financial reporting, providing a completely pristine, low-turnover fundamental anchor with 0 approved alphas in the database.
confounders: Protracted macro recessions delaying fundamental earnings realization
Discrepancies in corporate reporting calendars across different fiscal quarters
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if speculative non-profitable growth stocks outperform high-quality style leaders.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutral composite factor score derivative with short-term price reversal overlay
